title: Coast Guard Air Station Savannah rescues 3 people near Tybee Island, Georgia
credit: U.S. Coast Guard video, courtesy Air Station Savannah
description: A Coast Guard Air Station Savannah helicopter crew rescues three people after their vessel grounded near Tybee Island, Georgia, April 5, 2025. The helicopter crew safely hoisted the individuals and transported them to Hunter Army Airfield in Savannah, Georgia. (U.S. Coast Guard video, courtesy Air Station Savannah)
